observer_acceptance_algorithm: First preserve exact sealed agent version/schema/JAR, filename-PID, self birth parsing, directory/user.home/predef, allowed phase and command-role checks. Keep parse/native birth comparison implementation and precision semantics; no wider tolerance.
If java_command_present=true, preserve native exact self tracking as mandatory. An ancestry record cannot substitute for an untracked semantic JVM, even if it reaches the host.

Validate ancestry object exact fields/types/bounds; node0 equals top-level self/directparent; all links contiguous with exact repeated PID+birth data; no duplicatePID/cycle/inconsistent identity. Check parent birth <=child birth at available timestamp precision; equality is allowed, as actual99171/99172 share millisecond birth.
For normal tracked JVMs retain existing direct-parent tracked/host proof and any applicable ancestry structural validation. Do not expand semantic role acceptance.

Only a command-absent version-check JVM already allowed diagnostic-only by current policy can use the new chain when its self/directparent was not tracked. Walk its nonempty contiguous ancestry prefix until an existing native tracked PID or exact invocation host PID is reached. Compare that anchor Java birth using existing _native_birth_comparison against the corresponding retained native or host identity. Any matching PID with wrong birth fails immediately; do not skip it to find a more favorable ancestor.

A trusted anchor must be an ancestor, never the untracked self. A PID shared with another witness alone is not a trusted anchor. Files in the event directory, declared role, agent version, matching user.home, or matching invocation token cannot substitute for a trusted PID/birth anchor.

Unknown/foreign chain, cycle, missing link, wrong/recycled-root birth, absent requiredsemantic JVM, or truncation/unavailable before reaching an exact trustedanchor fails closed. A complete valid prefix reaching an exact anchor need not claim ancestry above that anchor; termination beyond an already-proven anchor is recorded diagnostically, not completeness. This scope must be explicit in tests and policy, not blanket acceptance of truncated chains.

Record correlation method, exact anchor PID/birth/source, validated link prefix and diagnostic-only classification separately from native birth_verified. Preserve raw chain and all rejected receipts; result remains null on any observer failure; retained returned process record preserved.
